prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Atlanta for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for every car-accident case — the right lawyer depends on the specifics of your case (severity of injuries, fault issues, insurance limits, whether you need a lawyer who will go to trial, language needs, budget, etc.). I can help you find the best match for your situation. Quick questions:

- How serious are your injuries (minor, moderate, severe, fatality)?
- Was the other driver clearly at fault? Were police/accident reports taken?
- Do you have health insurance or PIP/UM coverage issues?
- Do you prefer a big firm or a small local firm? Any language or accessibility needs?
- Are you looking for immediate representation or just information to pick one?

What I can do next
- If you answer the questions above I’ll research and give a short, vetted list of Atlanta attorneys/firms tailored to your case (with contact info and why I picked them).
- If you prefer to start right away, I can list the questions to ask at a free consultation and the criteria to evaluate lawyers.

How to choose a good Atlanta car-accident lawyer (quick checklist)
- Experience: handled many car-accident claims and cases similar to yours; trial experience if your case might go to court.
- Track record: meaningful settlements/verdicts and client testimonials (not just marketing claims).
- Communication: returns calls, explains options in plain language.
- Fee structure: contingency fee (no upfront fees) and clear costs/expenses policy.
- Resources: staff, medical/rehab connections, accident reconstruction experts if needed.
- Local knowledge: familiarity with Georgia traffic law and local courts.
- Ethics and standing: active license with Georgia State Bar, no serious disciplinary history.

Questions to ask in the free consultation
- Have you handled cases like mine? What were the results?
- Who will handle my case (attorney or paralegal)?
- What’s your fee? Any upfront costs?
- How do you communicate and how often?
- Do you go to trial if needed?

Immediate actions if your accident was recent
- Get medical attention and keep records.
- Preserve photos, police report, contact info for witnesses.
- Don’t give recorded statements to insurers without a lawyer.
- Note lost wages and expenses.

Tell me the case details or which of the next steps you want (a tailored shortlist, consultation questions in printable form, or immediate do-this-now steps), and I’ll proceed.
